# anitomy 0.0.35

Bundled from the official npm registry package `anitomy@0.0.35`:
`https://registry.npmjs.org/anitomy/-/anitomy-0.0.35.tgz`

Official registry integrity: `sha512-lwTWQAWKrgvQhlTssPDqz+1BVYJ7EqNVo7OTsqyND0SoVehOgdIdDZKeaAXI+D8z7xAV/fABWBZsVpbURF1MBg==`

The downloaded tarball SHA-512 was verified against this value before extraction. The pure JavaScript ESM distribution was retained locally and its module export was adapted to expose `globalThis.AnitomyBundled`; it is concatenated into plugin entry points at build time.
